data.query: site:nextdoor.com Dal-Tex Glass & Screens, LLC Mesquite

reviews.text: Great and fast work. Had my regular screens replaced with solar screens. They did an amazing job and pretty quick. The new screens look great and help block a lot of that daily sun I get. 5/5 would recommend.
reviews.author: Barry Moore

reviews.text: Danny came out quickly on my first call.  He measured my window that had fogged up, and gave me a great quote.  However, he noticed my window may still be under warranty from 15 years ago, and advised me to try to contact the maker of the window.  This took a sale and money away from his own company.  I was able to get the glass from the manufacturer, but knew Danny was the guy for the install.  He and his team came today and replaced the window, explaining everything he was doing.  I highly recommend Dal-Tex Glass & Screens for your next window project.
reviews.author: Dennis Farley

reviews.text: We had two windows that had gotten "foggy" and choose to replace the glass instead of the entire window. We also needed solar screens on several windows to help with the heat from the sun. Dal-Tex responded very quickly to my first inquiry and gave me a reasonable quote and great advice on which types of products would work best for our house. Installation of 4 window sections and two solar screens only took about an hour and a half and was completed quickly and professionally. We would not hesitate to recommend DalTex for any window needs!
reviews.author: Jennifer Masters

reviews.text: Danny & his team replaced 5 windows on our house.  They were punctual & professional.  Great price & great materials! I will definitely use Dal-Tex again! Before & after photos below!
reviews.author: Cent Shaw

reviews.text: Danny and his team did a great job! They were quick and professional. The prices are also very good. I called on Monday and my subdue was fixed by 9am the next day with no extra fees or nonsense. I would definitely recommend!
reviews.author: Leslie Rehm

reviews.text: We have a back door with a window and another window next to it. We have been wanting to get in window blinds to keep the dogs out of them. Danny and Jay came out at the time we agreed upon. The install went fairly quick. Danny knows his stuff. We also got a smaller in window blind for our master bedroom door. As well as replaced  a missing screen on a different window. Extremely happy with them. They look great! Thank you Danny and Jay for taking care of us! Wouldn’t hesitate to give them a call for your window needs.
reviews.author: Mike Foxtrot

reviews.text: The guys did a great job replacing all of our old windows on our rental property.  We got a great deal and they delivered just when they said they would.  Very easy to work with.  Highly recommend.
reviews.author: L Wilde

reviews.text:
What a world of difference with our new picture window!  Our den was dark and dreary before,  but with the new picture window, the change is amazing and the room is bright and refreshing! Can’t wait until the pool is finished. What a view! Thank you Dal-Tex. Y’all did an awesome job. We couldn’t be happier!
Kelly McCann and Kathy Pinkston
Carrollton, TX
reviews.author: Kathy Baldwin-Pinkston

reviews.text:
Excellent service, Quality Work,such Great honest friendly service,they will deliver and definitely leave you Smiling!
I'm happy,my window looks fabulous!
reviews.author: Carol New

reviews.text:
Thank you, Gerald!!!
A recent real estate transaction of mine required the window glass to be repaired, and we were able to stay on track with closing because of Gerald’s speed going out to the home for the estimate, and ordering what was needed.
A different company in the area told me they needed 6-8 weeks to get the job done.

Very professional and friendly with my clients and I. Competitive pricing (half of what the other company estimated!).
reviews.author: Chris Gomez (Chris Gomez Real Estate)

reviews.text: Dal-Tex did a great job and the prices are very reasonable. I had some complex arch windows that I wanted solar screens for. They do all the work in their workshop and installation day takes under an hour for the whole house.
reviews.author: Michael Soulary

reviews.text:
I had been looking for glass replacement on a couple of windows, so I did not have to fully replace my windows. This was the first company to happily oblige. They told me they can do the full window or just replace the glass whatever I’m looking for.

No hard sales pitches, no frills. Just a great team who took care of my windows at a reasonable price. I will use their services again in the future.

Thank you Dal-Tex!
reviews.author: John Smith

reviews.text: Had 2 windows replaced in a rental unit.  Danny measured the day after I called and replaced the windows the day following their arrival from the manufacturer.  Quick and easy.  Note the glass is a different color on the after photos because the other windows have tinting and the new window is not yet tinted.  Thanks, Dal-Tex and Danny!
reviews.author: Amanda Ballard

reviews.text: A+ service! Showed up when they said they would, very respectful of my home, plants and pets. In and out in 30 mins, no price gouging, nice window panel too. Would recommend!
reviews.author: nunezgirl4

reviews.text: Have used them several times, and they always do a fantastic job.  You can't beat their service quality or their prices.
reviews.author: Jennifer Parks

reviews.text: I recently contracted Dal-Tex Glass to replace a number of windows  in my home.  Service was exceptional, arrival to do the work punctual, pricing was fair & quoted up front, and completion done on time.  Dal-Tex was referred to me from a seasoned roofing company who uses their services and I would highly recommend Dal-Tex for window replacement jobs in the DFW metroplex!
reviews.author: perry neal

reviews.text: Called around to several places and Danny with Dal-Tex got back with us super quick and was so friendly and helpful.  When he came out to replace our broken window he was professional and personable and did an amazing job. It was not an easy job, but he was able to knock it out quickly and it looked amazing when he was finished.  I would definitely use them again and recommend Danny and Dal-Tex!
reviews.author: Robin Woodall

reviews.text: Danny at Dal-Tex did a fantastic job replacing our old framed shower door with a beautiful frameless, farm-style door. It's amazing how much it updates our bathroom.  Great work by Dal-Tex!
reviews.author: Tom Southard

reviews.text: My new windows look great!  The guys arrived when they said they were going to, and did exactly what we discussed.  Thank you!
reviews.author: Jon Myers

reviews.text: Helped me out on a jobsite with a broken window. Fast and easy to work with and fair price. Will use again.
reviews.author: Derek Munger

reviews.text: Excellent work! I had top side glass on a window fixed , had it done in no time. Thank you Danny!!!
reviews.author: Brenda b

reviews.text: Always professional and courteous. Fair pricing and efficient installation. Never disappointed with this company.
reviews.author: Vicki Duvall

reviews.text: I would highly recommend DAL-TEX for residential window replacement.  Danny will come to measure, provide an estimate, and then measure again before ordering the window to be made.  The installation process was quick and they cleaned up before leaving.  I will certainly use DAL-TEX again for future window replacements.
reviews.author: Les Myrah

reviews.text: These people are awesome they can replace it repair it do anything you need with windows
reviews.author: Bill Nix

reviews.text: Gerald & Danny , fast & efficient & very reasonably priced , & we will definitely use them Again 😀‼️
reviews.author: Sammy Walker

reviews.text: Dal-Tex Glass was very professional in their work, Gerald, Danny, and their crew worked continuously throughout the morning and had my windows done pretty quick. They set up tarps to catch all the debris cleaned up after themselves, and when the job was done look like nobody was even there. I would strongly recommend this company for any of your windows and solar screen needs also very fair priced thank you Dal- Tex Glass
reviews.author: Caesar Salazar

reviews.text: I have been working with Dal-Tex for many years. First screens and now replacement of windows. The house was built in "83" and with the increase in utilities I decided I would be saving for the future. It's a family owned business which was important to me. I have received several compliments and the owners are always available to answer questions and make sure you also are a happy customer. They have before and after pictures on their website so if you are in the process of deciding make sure you check them out!
reviews.author: Mary Mcnally

reviews.text: Danny and his team at Dal-Tex are the best! We had to meet some deadlines and requirements prior to selling our home and he worked with me to get repairs complete and had solutions for us.  Professional and the very beat customer service!
reviews.author: Belinda Bennett

reviews.text: Gerald and his team are so easy and pleasant to work with. They provided a very competitive quote for replacing all the windows in my home. I decided to replace half the windows now and half later, and they were very accommodating. About 5 to 6 weeks after the quote, the windows were ready to be installed and they showed up right when they said they would. The install only took a couple of hours for 5 windows. They worked quickly and cleaned up after themselves, even vacuuming the area. I plan to have the windows replaced for the other half of my house later in the year, and will be using Dal-Tex again. Thank you Dal-Tex for the amazing customer service and quality work.
reviews.author: Rachel

reviews.text: Danny & his team did an awesome job replacing my sliding glass door. They were very efficient, provided great customer and you can tell they were very experienced. I forgot to mention very affordable. I thought the replacement would hit me deep in my pockets but they really blessed me. Please give them a holler for your next repair or replacement.
reviews.author: Tedeisha Burch

reviews.text: Excellent company, reasonable prices and top notch workers and owner!
reviews.author: Cesar Signal

reviews.text: Dal Tex was recommended to us by a contractor whom we had trusted for over 20 years.  We also reviewed their website and selected them over Home Depot, Lowes and 2 major replacement glass companies.  We selected them because we knew that we could deal with the owners immediately without going through lots of layers of management.  We were not disappointed.  They did a superior job of replacing all the windows in our 55 year-old home.  They were friendly, polite and careful.  Absolutely no clean-up problem.  The work was done at a very reasonable price.  We have since used them on 2 much smaller jobs on other properties.  We would not hesitate to use them again.
reviews.author: Miles Schulze

reviews.text: Excellent service, communication and truly professional! I’ll certainly be working with Dal Tex for all future glass/window needs.
reviews.author: Meredith Denbow

reviews.text: Most professional two people I've ever had.  They came and repaired my window which was installed by NT Windows and they did not put the screws in and Window separated from wall.  Dal Tex Windows are honest and dependable.  Will definitely use them again and they are highly recommended by me.Finished my job much quicker than expectedly
reviews.author: Melva Smith

reviews.text: A pleasure to deal with, kept me in the loop with when the glass came in and worked with my schedule for installation.
reviews.author: Kary L

reviews.text: Based on a referral, I obtained two replacement security screens from Dal-Tex, and was impressed with the promptness, quality, and fair price. After speaking to Gerald about some old windows which were way past their life, He gave me a phone quote, then sent someone to measure.  The windows were received and installed in less than 3 weeks. Mark and Danny did a great job, working efficiently and with little disruption to our household. Later, Gerald himself showed up to say hello.  We are very happy with our four new windows and with the company as a whole - highly recommend them!
reviews.author: Gary Prudhomme

reviews.text: If I were able to give more than 5 stars, I would. Danny and his crew were great to work with from day one. I received a call back shortly after calling the first time, we hit it off right away. The quality and value for the price can’t be beat. Even if I found another solar screen company to do the job less expensive, I would’ve stuck with DalTex. Down to earth, easy going business that treats you  with respect and insight. We will more than likely have the guys come back later in the year to do the entire rear of our home with solar screens as this time around we only did the front.
reviews.author: Greg Frabotta

reviews.text: If you're looking for an honest and dependable company, look no further, y'all! Dal-Tex has replaced half the windows in my house (and will replace the other half once we're ready to do so), and they just recently finished installing our custom barn-door style glass shower door. It's beautiful, and we wouldn't be any more satisfied with their level of quality and customer service. I have, and will continue to, refer them to anyone I know.
reviews.author: Amanda Sheffler

reviews.text: Gerald and the crew are wonderful! He replaced our existing window screens with solar screens. We contacted him again to replace custom order glass. His pricing is very reasonable! It was actually less expensive than we had anticipated. He made the whole process very pleasant and completed work above our expectations. His staff is courteous, professional and punctual! We were so happy with his work at our home, that we are confident in also referring Dal-Tex to our customers. It is a pleasure doing business with Dal-Tex! Thank you guys! 🙂
reviews.author: Jen Mac

reviews.text: Danny and the Dal Tex team are top notch! Awesome communication and the best service. They replaced all the glass window panes that needed replacement and went above and beyond their job. Fantastic price too! Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Beth Arnold

reviews.text: Dal-Tex did a great job replacing my Mother's broken window in Mesquite, TX. Danny was very responsive and did a great job for a fair price! I recommend this company for all your window needs.
reviews.author: Mike Paris

reviews.text: Dal-Tex has been my go to for anything window related. I'm a contractor and have trusted them to help me and my clients for over a decade. From solar screens, window replacements, and frameless shower glass, I've always had a great experience.
reviews.author: Josh Martin

reviews.text: Gerald, Danny and Team did a phenomenal job at our house. They replaced over 20 windows. They were precise, informative and patient in the pre-work visit, and they helped us through the selection of the product. The installation work was flawless with incredible level of detail and kept us informed throughout. They left our home in pristine conditions, taking away every single piece of debris that was created during the job. They are family owned and operated and take pride and accountability for what they do. We are thrilled with their work and the outcome as well as the value for money. Exceptional company, would recommend them to anyone.
reviews.author: Mauro Schiavon

reviews.text: This company was amazing! I was in a bind to close on a house, and they came out and did at least five window panes all in one day! I will definitely use them again. They were so professional and even cleaned up after themselves. Truly a company that values their customers!
reviews.author: hsnnut

reviews.text: I have used Daltex since 2009. As a real estate agent ,they are the only window/glass company I personally use and refer to my clients,neighbors and friends/family. I also use them exclusively on all the rental properties I currently property manage and have manged in the past. These guys are the definition of skilled, quality work.
reviews.author: Karen Green

reviews.text: Amazing!!!  We had all of our windows replaced and they were very professional, courteous, honest, personable, and just great all around!!  We would definitely recommend this company.  They showed up on time, were up front about what all was involved with the project, and did quality work.  They definitely went above and beyond.
reviews.author: Stacey King

reviews.text: We used Dal Tex to get new screen doors put on 2 different sized sliding doors.  The product is excellent. A different company told us our only option was to replace the whole doors, but Dal Tex was able to make it work.
reviews.author: Emily Goetz

reviews.text: I have used Dal-Tex for the last 6 years on numerous window and solar screens jobs. They are A+. Always on time, good communication, great pricing and top notch installation. Everyone I have recommended them to has said the same. I won’t use anyone else.
reviews.author: Devon Riddell

reviews.text: Great service. Had a contractor put in the wrong window and Dal Tex fixed it. Very responsive and polite. Good quick work. Looking forward to a non-leaky window. Dont rely on contractors, use Dal Tex
reviews.author: Matthew Glicksman

reviews.text: I have been a customer of Dal-Tex for over 10 years. Excellent customer service and they are always there when you need them. As a local Realtor its important to be able to refer quality people to my clients and they have never let me down. I would refer them to anyone!!! Highly recommend!!!
reviews.author: Scott Evans

reviews.text: Called to get a price to replace my screens the dogs had destroyed. He told me the price over the phone, stopped by the next day to see how many and what size, then came by the day after to install them. He even fixed a window that was broken and disposed of all the old screens. Can't imagine better service or a better deal. Highly recommend this company.
reviews.author: Lynn Patterson

reviews.text: Was very happy with the work done to my window screens.  It was done right there while I waited, and not too long.  If you need screens done this is the place to go.
reviews.author: Mary Garcia

reviews.text: Incredible service. Gerold and Danny have fixed window issues, replaced glass, made big and solar screens for me. They are always honest about the issue at hand and have very competitive prices. If their price is higher than someone else, it’s because you need more than the other guy. They’ve come through for me on every project.
reviews.author: Bobby Floyd

reviews.text: Danny and his team were great to work with. They were flexible around scheduling and kept us up to date. Would use again and recommend to friends.
reviews.author: Colby Morgan

reviews.text:
Our experience has always been good.
We have used them a few times,  they are very personable, responsive,  economical and fast.
Dal-Tex is a top notch company and they do great work.
reviews.author: Samuel f

reviews.text:
We really Love our new screens,
5 star product 5 star company!!
Thank you Danny & Crew!!!
reviews.author: R Fry

reviews.text: He was very nice and kind. He took his time to make sure that my doors were fixed, he didnt rush, which I appreciate. Thank you!
reviews.author: Gloria Ker

reviews.text: I am a realtor (15 years) with Century 21 Judge Fite.  I have used this company for years to replace windows and screens.  Additionally, I have referred them to family, friends and clients.  This company is family owned.  I just love Gerald (owner) and Danny (son).  They are very personable, respond quickly, do professional quality work, and have reasonable prices.
reviews.author: Deborah Allen

reviews.text: Really appreciate you putting a much needed window in. Personally, I didn't know what to do because, I had to break the old window out...just to get in and help a family member laying on the floor in much need of medical help. Fast service and friendly workers. Again, thank you very much for replacing our window.
reviews.author: Kenneth Tackett

reviews.text: Danny with DAL-TEX Glass was on time, efficient, and friendly. We highly recommend  Danny and Gerald for window replacement and repair.
reviews.author: Mark Massa

reviews.text: Dal-Tex works above and beyond. From screen replacement to glass replacement, they were quick and courteous. Personally like the family owned businesses over franchise because of true customer service. These guys are the best
reviews.author: Vic Saffle

reviews.text: Danny came the same day I called, gave me an estimate and had the window installed by the following week! His was the lowest price and he was accommodating my crazy schedule!
reviews.author: Jess

reviews.text: Replaced all the windows in our home.  Great quality product, excellent installation, and super competitive price.  Followed up to make sure we were happy.  Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Laura Horton

reviews.text: I had a broken window. I called got an appt and got a price quoted.  Danny showed up on time finished the work at the quoted price. It was simple and easy. Will use them over and over if I need Windows replaced or new Windows.
reviews.author: Kevin Johnson

reviews.text: Highly recommend. They went above and beyond our expectation. Very professional, efficient, and our windows look awesome! It put the finishing touch on our home. Thank you Dal-Tex Glass!
reviews.author: rikki sennikoff

reviews.text: GAME CHANGER. My family and I are very satisfied with our decision to chose Dal-Tex for our solar screens. The house stays much more cool and we have more privacy as an added bonus. To top it off, measurement and installation took less than 20 minutes!
reviews.author: Lynn Eastep

reviews.text: Very responsive people.  Broken window was ordered and replaced in a very timely manner.  Very quick installation and clean up.  Call them for your windows.  Very professional at a good price!
reviews.author: J Bernal

reviews.text: I purchased 10 windows. My Living room was a great concern, 12 ft. by 12 ft., but I wanted to be able to have a window I could open. They came through with a window that didn't block my view and also gave me a window I could open. Very pleased with the windows and the installation. Highly recommended.
reviews.author: Darrell Somers

reviews.text: I have used Dal-Tex multiple times. Always professional and responsive!
reviews.author: Keith Faulhaber

reviews.text: They did a great and fast job replacing a broken window and they are reasonable I would definitely call them again if I ever have have any window issues. great company!
reviews.author: Audrey Gabaldon

reviews.text: Great guy to do business with good prices and good products. We had them put in 7 mores windows.    Only 2 left after we. Save up some money
reviews.author: Phillip Johnson

reviews.text: I am beyond impressed with the customer service Danny and Gerald provide. When you work with Dal-Tex you will not be disappointed. Exceptional integrity, kindness and true to their word! -Kelsey
reviews.author: Kelsey Julian

reviews.text: This is a great father/son company! They were both very kind, efficient and flexible! If I ever need more solar screens or a window replaced, I will certainly be calling them for help!
reviews.author: mandy winkler

reviews.text: Danny was very professional. Helped us choose what we were looking for, very informative. Came in did what he said he was gonna do, stuck to his quote no surprises. Very easy to get ahold of and definitely went above and beyond our expectations. Here is a before and after.
reviews.author: Julio Ventura

reviews.text: Great work!! I needed a side glass replaced next to my front door and Dal-Tex was fast, reasonable, and professional. 100% would recommend!
reviews.author: Gordo2100

reviews.text: Great experience with DAL-TEX. Quick response time and easy process for getting a window replaced.
reviews.author: Matt Partain (Itsfiine)

reviews.text: Never had such a nice Friendly repair man that showed and explained every thing that he was doing replacing the patio door.  Knows his stuff.  Highly recommend him
reviews.author: J. W. SMITH

reviews.text: Danny was great. We got our glass early, and he was very friendly and professional as well.
reviews.author: chuck kelly

reviews.text: Dal-Tex  windows and screens were great, they measured and installed within a week snd a half. Great company to deal with.
reviews.author: Julie Colletti

reviews.text: Great service and awesome workmanship!  Would recommend to anyone!
reviews.author: Judy Spilker

reviews.text: The best and most reliable screen and window installer in DFW.
reviews.author: Brian Luneau

reviews.text:
These guys sealed my windows and replaced some glass in a home I was selling. Danny even inspected  the windows in the home Im purchasing. These guys are professional and quick.
Chet D. Arnold
reviews.author: Chet D. Arnold

reviews.text: Danny and his crew did an amazing job replacing our foggy windows. Could not be happier!
reviews.author: Paul

reviews.text: These guys are great very on time.  They get the meteral quick very professional.I highly recommend them I am a contractor my self highly recommended them!!!!!!!10+++++
reviews.author: C rogers Lowe

reviews.text: Professional, on time, knowledgeable, cleaned up after work was complete- would recommend Dal-Tex for sure. Good value!
reviews.author: Patrick Hogan

reviews.text: Very professional service. Great work and the people couldn’t be nicer to work with. On time and finished. Cleaned up. The best
reviews.author: terry Simons

reviews.text: Extremely nice and helpful!  Went above and beyond to make sure everything was done well and took great care of us!   I recommend them and will Definitely use them again!
reviews.author: Amy Threadgill

reviews.text: First time user but very happy and impressed with service. Definitely a phone number to have for home needs.
reviews.author: Tony Banda

reviews.text: These guys were wonderful to work with. On time, reliable, and do quality work at a reasonable price. Would highly recommend!!
reviews.author: Brandon Underwood

reviews.text: Great attention to detail and patience with a moving timeline. Easy going guys that know what they are doing. Reasonable prices too and very responsive. Can’t recommend enough.
reviews.author: Chris Willis

reviews.text: Needed 4 screens made...said it would take 20 minutes...was complete perfectly in about 7 minutes!  Definitely would recommend Dal-Tex!
reviews.author: Diana

reviews.text: Gerald,Danny and crew were responsive. Work completed as promised. We are extremely happy
reviews.author: Mike Snapp

reviews.text: Quick, efficient and friendly. We are very happy with their work.
reviews.author: Lydia Blair (Lydia B)

reviews.text: Needed a quick replacement screen and frame. In and out of the door in just a few minutes. I will be back  if I ever need screens again.
reviews.author: Roger Harris

reviews.text: It is nice to work with a company that does what they say,  when they say, for what they said.
reviews.author: Troy Gray

reviews.text: Great product.  Great pricing.  Excellent company to work with.
reviews.author: Andrew Lester

reviews.text: On time, easy to work with, and great customer service.
reviews.author: Colby Odom

reviews.text: Was quick to answer and very friendly over the phone.
reviews.author: David Deleon

reviews.text: Their listed phone number online is a fax number. There's no way to call them.
reviews.author: Christopher Welch

reviews.text: Quality service and quick installation
reviews.author: James Kearns
